svg.title: Commit Activity × AI Collaboration — All time
svg.desc: Daily commit heatmap 2025-08-20 to 2026-08-19: 1745 commits, 1242 AI-assisted (71%), publishable repositories only. Intensity is total commits (the owner's own commits included); hue is the day's AI share. Generated 2026-08-23.
